title: token erc20
tagline: SimpleERC20 is a lightweight and efficient ERC-20 token with standard functionality, designed for easy integration and seamless transactions. Built for simplicity and reliability, it follows best practices for Ethereum token contracts
description:
SimpleERC20 is a standard ERC-20 token deployed on Ethereum, designed for straightforward and efficient token transfers. It implements the core ERC-20 functions, including transfer, approve, and transferFrom, allowing seamless interaction with wallets, exchanges, and DeFi protocols.

The contract follows best practices for security and gas efficiency, ensuring safe and predictable token behavior. It includes essential features like a fixed supply, ownership management, and event emissions for better transparency.

While this project is minimalistic, it serves as a foundational building block for various blockchain applications, including payments, governance, and tokenized assets.
how_its_made:
I built SimpleERC20 using Solidity and deployed it on the Ethereum network. The smart contract follows the ERC-20 standard and was developed using Foundry, which provided a fast and efficient testing environment.

To ensure reliability, I used OpenZeppelin’s ERC-20 implementation as a foundation, reducing security risks and following best practices. The contract was written with minimal complexity, avoiding unnecessary modifications to keep it gas-efficient and easy to audit.

For testing, I leveraged Foundry’s fuzz testing capabilities to verify edge cases and ensure correct token behavior under various conditions. While this project is straightforward, the goal was to create a clean and robust implementation that adheres to Ethereum standards.
